title: Sequences

content:
Update of the seq3 module by @CritterandGuitari for Orac 2.0 (Organelle) with a metronome, a faster aux menu showing the revision number and global CPU usage, receiving beat-clock / 360 ppqn instead of master-ticks / 24 ppqn to be able to handle swing from the clock without tempo drops, also receiving signature reset-bang from the Transport module for more stability, with more conventionnal LED colors and visual feedback over the playing sequence length.

#1 copy sequence_4-2.zop into /Patches
#2 reload the Organelle (menu Storage -> Reload)
#3 run "Install sequences_4-2..."

(will be installed into /media/orac/usermodules/sequence)

v 4.2 : UI bugfix

v 4.1 : - compatibility with the Transport module, 24ppq option removed, module slot name added in the bottom left corner
